naslov: What is a kernel in AI? Explained in 30 seconds
opis:
A kernel is a small piece of low-level code that tells a chip exactly how to do one math job, and every chip family needs its own set. Anthropic says its internal model Mythos got Claude running on AMD chips in three days, almost without humans, by writing or porting nearly all the kernels. That job used to take dozens of engineers months.
